name: Install Node via nvm + pnpm (Linux/macOS)
description: nvm, the current Node LTS, and pnpm enabled through Corepack. Linux and macOS — on Windows use nvm-windows, or run this inside WSL.
author: voltius

snippets.name: Install nvm
snippets.description: Pinned to a release tag rather than a branch, so the script you run is the one that was reviewed.

steps.content:
curl -o- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvm-sh/nvm/v0.40.6/install.sh | bash

# nvm is a shell function, so a new shell (or this) is needed before nvm works.
export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"
[ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"
nvm --version

snippets.name: Install Node LTS
snippets.description: Installs the current LTS and makes it the default for new shells.

steps.content:
export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"
[ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"

nvm install --lts
nvm alias default 'lts/*'
node --version
npm --version

snippets.name: Enable pnpm via Corepack
snippets.description: Corepack ships with Node, so pnpm needs no separate installer.

steps.content:
export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"
[ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"

npm install --global corepack@latest
corepack enable pnpm
pnpm --version
